publicReleaseNotes: Lamp 1.8.1 fixes backup and restore for owners on Run Edit Run Managed hosting and adds an Uptime alert preset. Lamp's technical backup and restore (node scripts/export.mjs and node scripts/import.mjs) did not recognise the migration history Run Edit Run keeps in a Managed database (the rer_migrations table): a backup carried that history as if it were page data, a restore into a new Managed installation was refused, and a restore could have overwritten the destination's own history. Lamp 1.8.1 treats that table as installation history: a backup and a restore both check that it lists exactly this release's migrations with their file hashes and refuse otherwise, the backup never carries it, and a restore into a new Managed installation (before its owner signs in) writes your data without touching the new installation's history. A backup made by 1.8.0 from a Managed installation restores too, and any other unknown table still stops a restore. Self-hosted backups and restores are unchanged. Alerts → Connect Uptime takes Uptime's signed JSON webhook, maps each Uptime monitor to a component, opens a private draft with the failing vantages in the incident brief, refuses stale or unsigned requests, and records recovery. One migration, 0040, applies on update; back up first. The checkout pins rer 0.2.63. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/lamp-1.7.0-status-page-1440.png

migrations.buyerSteps: Apply after 0039. Adds signed Uptime preset identification and monitor-to-component mappings. Existing sources and credentials are retained; configure an Uptime source explicitly in Alerts.

agentUpdateInstructions: Back up data and owner source first: node scripts/export.mjs --remote with the deployment's --env-file, plus Settings → Export page data. Update the checkout to v1.8.1 and run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (rer 0.2.63 pin, unchanged), then rer deploy with the same environment and input file; it applies migration 0040_uptime_preset.sql, which adds Uptime preset columns to alert sources and changes no existing source. On Run Edit Run Managed hosting, back up and restore with node scripts/export.mjs and node scripts/import.mjs as OPERATIONS.md describes; the Managed migration ledger rer_migrations is checked and kept on each installation, never archived or written. Run rer verify and pnpm run validate:release before adopting.
